subject: design/fleet-bridge-v1
statement: The bridge changes **when**, never **how**: plan-freeze becomes an ordinary await — when the drive stops at a frozen plan's introducing proposal it registers "plan merged at mainline" with the wake channel; the resumed touch verifies the freeze at the goal object, then triggers projection **through the planning stage's own contract** — consent, staged modes, idempotency, and wiring order exactly as that design binds them — with no human prompt; each created item is verified at the goal object (it exists and carries the repo-configured automated-implementation tag) and journaled; re-triggers and racing wakes land the guarantee the projection contract actually gives, split by case — a re-trigger with the items already live records a journaled no-op and creates nothing (UB-6's case), and a true concurrent both-probe-miss race lands the stage's own **detected halt**: the report names both items, routing is withheld for the pair, and the drive surfaces it loudly (journaled, alarmed per the stage's posture) — never silent duplication, never auto-repair, never a bespoke lock around the stage. In-flight proposals are driven to **content-verified landings** through the lane's routing, and the feature closes only when every proposal's content is an ancestor of the mainline. The pipeline map's stage-8 row is corrected to state the binding **as it operationally runs** — the map is the live surface that owns that value, and no drive guidance may direct deferring materialization on the row's account. (design-brainstorm:argus-unattended-drive-tech-design#D-6)
